pathways.compact_statement: The UN reports that contested dam access amid prolonged drought preceded a deadly intercommunal clash in Namibe in August 2025; it does not establish climate as the sole cause or a national violence trend.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing access rules, local disputes, governance and social relations may also shape violence; the report does not isolate them.
pathways.uncertainty: One UN-reported historical episode. No named communities, independently identified climate effect, anthropogenic drought attribution or current violence map.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.
